# Policy-KB bijection audit — autopay_authorization_changes / task 1

Scope: extended policies `autopay_ext_unit_draft_notice` (root) and `autopay_ext_unit_ach_catchup`; the base policies they reference (`autopay_evt_varying_amount_notice`, `autopay_evt_expiry_reminders`, `autopay_evt_draft_amount_timing`, `autopay_evt_retry_and_suspension`, `autopay_evt_returns`) and the rest of the charter for the retired surface and reverse scan; AutoPay variant parameters; unit class figures (checked against `blueprint/products/unit.yaml` variants); task-tool contracts. Corpus: 51 `docs/autopay/*.json`. Audited 2026-10-10 after `runtime_context/autopay_authorization_changes/1.md` was frozen. This report is written separately from task 0; shared base-policy findings are re-checked here, not inherited.
